tasks.label: Build All
tasks.command: for dir in dfsc dfsdn dfsnn; do (cd $dir && make all && mv build/output/app ../$dir); done
tasks.detail: Build all projects using make and move executables to parent directory

tasks.label: Clean All
tasks.command: for dir in dfsc dfsdn dfsnn; do (cd $dir && make clean && rm -f ../$dir); done

tasks.label: Run All
tasks.command: for dir in dfsc dfsdn dfsnn; do ./$dir; done
tasks.detail: Run all compiled projects from the parent directory

tasks.label: Format All Code
tasks.command: for dir in dfsc dfsdn dfsnn; do clang-format -i $dir/**/*.{cpp,hpp,cppm}; done
tasks.detail: Format the code in all projects using clang-format

tasks.label: Run All Tests
tasks.command: for dir in dfsc dfsdn dfsnn; do (cd $dir && make test); done
tasks.detail: Run the tests for all projects
